name: Clearing Party And Time 14
definition: Specifies the central counterparty and clearing informations.

CCP.name: CCP
CCP.definition: In the case of a contract that has been cleared, the unique code for the clearing counterparty that has cleared the contract.

ClearingDateTime.name: Clearing Date Time
ClearingDateTime.definition: Time and date when clearing took place.

ReportTrackingNumber.name: Report Tracking Number
ReportTrackingNumber.definition: Unique number to indicate a group of reports which relate to the same execution.

PortfolioCode.name: Portfolio Code
PortfolioCode.definition: Unique code determined by the reporting counterparty identifying the portfolio.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
